answer: A farm generating text without memory of its own history thus fails the binding, as a result it has to store and read state per alias. Bindings are kept in cipher, verified in violet, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 6 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the basalt check. Ten thousand fake identities would need 87 days and roughly 6 million dollars to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
